query:
UPDATE post_schedule
             SET status = 'running'
             WHERE id = (
                 SELECT id FROM post_schedule
                 WHERE status = 'pending'
                   AND planned_at <= $1
                   AND planned_at > $1 - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
                 ORDER BY planned_at
                 LIMIT 1
                 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
             )
             RETURNING id, planned_at, block, planned_count, seq_in_day, schedule_ver
